drums.description: Afrobeat track in 4/4 time at 110 BPM, The arrangement features a syncopated electric bassline playing a repetitive two-bar groove, Percussion consists of a dry kick drum on every beat, a sharp snare on the 2 and 4, and a complex layer of congas and shakers providing sixteenth-note subdivisions, A clean-toned electric guitar plays muted, rhythmic staccato chords on the off-beats, A bright, brassy synthesizer enters with a melodic hook characterized by short, punchy notes and syncopated phrasing, The track maintains a steady, driving rhythmic pocket with minimal harmonic movement, focusing on the interplay between the percussive elements and the cyclic guitar and bass riffs Publish

bass.description: Funk, 110 BPM, G minor, The track features a syncopated electric bassline playing a repetitive 16th-note groove, A clean-toned electric guitar performs percussive, muted 'chika-chika' strumming patterns and staccato chord stabs on the off-beats, The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat patterns, A bright, percussive synth or clavinet-style keyboard provides rhythmic accents, The arrangement is built on a static harmonic vamp, emphasizing rhythmic interlocking between the bass and the muted guitar Publish
